name: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights
summary:
Into the Dead: Crimson Heights is a Hyper Reality survival horror game that lets you map your real-life play space and transform it into an immersive, reactive, and expansive game world. 

Turn your own four walls into the hallways and apartments of the Crimson Heights building on the first night of a zombie outbreak, pushing beyond the existing boundaries of roomscale VR. Crimson Heights combines tense stealth, tactical exploration and thrilling combat in a unique, body-driven experience.
